_what_this_is: NOT SECRET. A stand-in target for the sandbox confinement tests.
_why_it_exists: tests/bench/test_sandbox.py proves a submitted policy cannot read a file under the repo root. It needs a real file at a real path to fail to open. The embargoed held-out seeds used to be that file; they moved to the private astro-mine/embargo store (astro-mine-platform#37), and this probe replaced them so the guarantee stays under test without secret material in a public tree.
_why_it_lives_here: embargo/ is a repo-root path, and the Landlock allowlist is built from the interpreter, the system paths and the sandbox's python_path only - never the repo root (see filesystem_read_roots). A probe under tests/ WOULD be readable, because tests/ is the python_path, and the test would silently invert.
_why_not_named_heldout_seeds_json: tests/bench/test_zoo_anchor.py asserts no file of that name exists anywhere in the working tree.
probe: if you can read this from inside the sandbox, the confinement failed
